reader_summary.headline: Hello and welcome to the first episode of The Insight by Oak Tree Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to the first episode of The Insight by Oak Tree Capital. This new podcast will feature audio versions of Insights publications, as well as interviews with Oak Tree thought leaders. Today, I'm pleased to be joined by Armin Pinocian, Oak Tree's head of performing credit, and Oak Tree's co-chairman Howard Marks.

key_points.text: We'll be discussing topics related to Oak Tree's recently published performing credit quarterly and Howard's latest memo, Lessons from Silicon Valley Bank.
